title: CANVAS / CAPTURE / RECONSTRUCT / WEAR
asset_strategy: Lead with the source painting, move through reconstruction evidence, then land on a wearable hero using a JRR campaign shot and a product mockup. Keep the arc legible and sparse: archive first, product last.

slides.headline: CANVAS
slides.notes: Full-bleed oil painting detail on bone field; crop tight, let texture dominate, add only a small protocol label.

slides.headline: CAPTURE
slides.notes: Use pixelated reconstruction as evidence; feel like scan output, not design decoration. High contrast, quiet coordinates.

slides.headline: RECONSTRUCT
slides.notes: Treat as technical archive plate: grid, coordinate marks, fragment map, oxidized red accent only where needed.

slides.headline: FRAGMENT
slides.notes: Bring the garment forward as an object, not a mockup; emphasize graphic placement and material weight.

slides.headline: WEAR
slides.notes: Campaign-body shot in city/studio light; oversized fit, candid movement, strong shadow, premium streetwear energy.

slides.headline: ARCHIVE
slides.notes: Close crop on textile and body; make the fragment feel desirable and alive, with gallery/concrete restraint.

caption:
Extracted from the canvas.
Reconstructed into form.
Worn as a fragment.

image_concepts.name: Source Fragment Hero
image_concepts.brief: Create a premium cover image that makes the raw painting feel like the origin point of a desirable fashion object, with the art surface leading and the garment implied through system logic.
image_concepts.prompt: Editorial fashion campaign source image, image-only, no readable text, premium minimal composition on warm bone background with near-black and oxidized red tones, a physical oil painting fragment treated as an archive specimen and optical source, technical scan evidence atmosphere, sparse coordinate system cues, negative space, stark crop, tactile paint texture, art-to-wearable translation implied through projection and reconstruction logic, premium streetwear sensibility, oversized silhouette presence suggested in framing, city-studio-gallery mood, concrete glass metal textures, confident contemporary attitude, cinematic but restrained, social media worthy, high-end art-led streetwear campaign, no typography, no logos, no fake text.

image_concepts.name: Wearable Fragment Hero
image_concepts.brief: Show the garment as a desirable product first, with the painting fragment appearing as projected source material or overlay evidence in a real fashion campaign setting.
image_concepts.prompt: Premium streetwear campaign image, image-only, no readable text, styled body in motion wearing an oversized garment with graphic emphasis derived from an art fragment, strong product hero framing, tactile textile detail, natural movement, confident posture, city or studio gallery context with concrete, glass, and metal textures, bone background and near-black tonal balance with oxidized red accents pulled from source artwork, subtle optical scan and coordinate system feeling through lighting and composition, fragment source appears as projection/reflection/material evidence rather than decoration, clean desirable fashion advertising logic inspired by performance/lifestyle campaigns, candid motion, premium restraint, no fake typography, no logos, no graffiti, no hype aesthetics.

image_concepts.name: Archive Reconstruction Study
image_concepts.brief: Create a reconstruction-led image that feels like a system plate, bridging the canvas to the wearable object with a technical archive tone while still feeling fashion-forward.
image_concepts.prompt: Image-only editorial reconstruction study, no readable text, stark technical archive label aesthetic, near-black on bone background with oxidized red accents, optical scan artifacts, coordinate grid logic, magnified fragment mapping, reconstructed artwork data translated into garment evidence, premium minimal streetwear campaign framing, oversized silhouette implied through cropped product edges, concrete and glass studio environment cues, tactile textile texture, confident human presence suggested through motion blur and shadow, art-school archive meets fashion brand marketing, desirable product logic, no typography, no logos, no fake text inside the image.
